"""Prepare a source-feature review, never detector outputs or numerical truth."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont

ROOT=Path.cwd();DOC=ROOT/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11'
OUT=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-water-surface-localization-20261010-001'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def load(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def save(p,d):Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
assert not OUT.exists();OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
prior=load(DOC/'2026-10-10-temporal-texture-observation.json')
reply=load(DOC/'2026-10-10-later-water-role-reply.json')
case=next(c for c in prior['attempts'][-1]['preflight']['cases'] if c['case_id']=='water-f001438')
inputs=[DOC/'2026-10-10-temporal-texture-observation.json',DOC/'2026-10-10-later-water-role-reply.json',
        ROOT/case['source_raster']['path'],ROOT/'sample/output/s11-temporal-texture-20261010-003/water-f001438.npz']
pre=dict(schema='s11-source-review-preparation-v1',base_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
 source_case=case,inputs={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for p in inputs},
 purpose='Before proposing a numerical water-surface reference, distinguish two current source features near the existing diagnostic centre. No detector or numeric score is run.',
 source_region_xyxy=[740,250,1160,1080],detail_xyxy=[840,450,1070,540],diagnostic_column_x=950,
 markers=[dict(id='B1',representative_source_xy=[950,487],description='Upper faint bright feature; physical role unreviewed.'),
          dict(id='B2',representative_source_xy=[950,498],description='Lower stronger bright band; physical role unreviewed at this subfeature scope.')],
 marker_authority='Agent visual source locators, not Canny-derived candidates, exact human coordinates or proposed error tolerances.',
 review_question='Are B1 and B2 the rear/front projection of the same water surface, or is one the water surface and the other a reflection/bubble/other feature, or is the distinction unclear?',
 decision_dependency='Determines which observed feature, if any, may become a same-column surface-location reference. Water-surface presence alone does not identify every nearby bright edge.',
 closed_roles='B/C upper band: water surface without a Foam layer; A: Foam layer, lower boundary unclear. Do not ask those roles again or transfer a future B1/B2 answer to C.',
 constraints='No precise Y reference, tolerance, thickness, centre calibration or future numeric adoption is implied by a regional feature reply. Keep both alternatives if unclear; no nearest/strongest-edge choice.',
 outcome='PENDING_HUMAN_FEATURE_REVIEW',windows_required=False,production_change=False,
 runner_sha256=sha(__file__))
save(OUT/'preflight.json',pre);(OUT/'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
original=Image.open(ROOT/case['source_raster']['path']).convert('RGB')
assert sha(ROOT/case['source_raster']['path'])==case['source_raster']['sha256']
crop=original.crop(tuple(pre['source_region_xyxy']));detail=original.crop(tuple(pre['detail_xyxy']))
with np.load(inputs[-1],allow_pickle=False) as a:
    assert np.array_equal(np.array(crop)[:,:,::-1],a['crops'][7])
    canny_rows=[int(y+250) for y in np.flatnonzero(a['canny'][:,210]) if 450<=y+250<540]
BG=(17,24,32);FG=(235,240,246);MUTED=(172,187,204)
font=lambda n:ImageFont.truetype('/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf',n)
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(1440,1040),BG);draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
draw.text((24,20),'B | water surface location: two source features',font=font(29),fill=FG)
draw.text((24,60),'f1438 / 47.981 s. Foam-layer absence is already reviewed. Feature 1 / 2 remains unreviewed.',font=font(20),fill=MUTED)
draw.text((24,108),'Whole context (native pixels)',font=font(21),fill=FG)
canvas.paste(crop,(24,148))
draw.text((480,108),'Clean source detail (4x nearest-neighbour)',font=font(21),fill=FG)
enlarged=detail.resize((920,360),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
canvas.paste(enlarged,(480,148))
draw.text((480,553),'Same pixels with two approximate feature locators',font=font(21),fill=FG)
canvas.paste(enlarged,(480,598))
# Markers have deliberately separate clean panels; do not cover source-only proof.
colours=[(74,220,244),(255,173,72)]
for i,m in enumerate(pre['markers']):
    sx,sy=m['representative_source_xy'];px=480+(sx-840)*4;py=598+(sy-450)*4
    colour=colours[i];tx=1272;ty=(695,848)[i]
    draw.line((tx-12,ty+19,px+11,py),fill=colour,width=3)
    draw.ellipse((px-8,py-8,px+8,py+8),outline=colour,width=3)
    draw.rounded_rectangle((tx-2,ty-2,tx+69,ty+44),radius=8,fill=BG,outline=colour,width=2)
    draw.text((tx+15,ty+2),str(i+1),font=font(30),fill=colour)
draw.text((480,979),'Locators are agent annotations, not selected heights or ground truth.',font=font(19),fill=MUTED)
image_path=DOC/'2026-10-10-water-surface-feature-review.png';assert not image_path.exists();canvas.save(image_path)
# Verify the clean source panels exactly; checking overlays against raw would be wrong.
back=Image.open(image_path).convert('RGB')
assert np.array_equal(np.array(back.crop((24,148,444,978))),np.array(crop))
assert np.array_equal(np.array(back.crop((480,148,1400,508))),np.array(enlarged))
for p,digest in pre['inputs'].items():assert sha(ROOT/p)==digest,p
record=dict(schema='s11-source-feature-review-record-v1',preflight=pre,preflight_sha256=sha(OUT/'preflight.json'),
 image=dict(path=str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=sha(image_path),size=list(back.size)),
 clean_panels_equal_source=True,saved_anchor_crop_equal=True,inputs_preserved=True,
 old_canny_rows_in_detail=canny_rows,
 canny_interpretation='Saved raw edge locations are retained only as availability context. They do not name either physical feature or determine these visual locators.',
 disposition='PENDING_HUMAN_FEATURE_REVIEW',physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED',
 script=Path(__file__).read_text(),local_preflight=str((OUT/'preflight.json').relative_to(ROOT)))
save(DOC/'2026-10-10-water-surface-feature-review.json',record)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PREPARED_SOURCE_VERIFIED',image=str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT)),canny_rows=canny_rows)))
